title: Dual-recognition driven sensing platform based on a BSA-Cu NP nanozyme combined with smartphone-assistance for fluorometric/colorimetric monitoring of dopamine
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,199-206
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07209J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Da-Qian Feng, Shaofei Wang, Zhendi Yu, Wenfeng Zhang, Guoliang Liu
BSA-Cu NPs with peroxidase-mimicking activity are synthesized for dopamine detection based on fluorometric/colorimetric dual-mode. Besides, by integrating paper strips and smartphone software analysis, an intelligent recognition is also fabricated.
